name: Linker Script Helper
blurb: a linker script from sections and memory regions in a form
intro: Writes a GNU ld linker script for a Cortex-M part in the layout STM32CubeIDE and CMSIS startup files expect: vectors and code in flash, .data run in RAM and loaded from flash, .bss zeroed, a stack and heap reservation, and extra sections (CCM RAM, backup RAM, no-init) with the start-up code they need. It checks region overlaps, alignment and whether the stack and heap fit.

inputs.label: Memory regions
inputs.help: From the datasheet memory map; lengths like 512K or 0x80000.

inputs.label: Extra sections
inputs.help: init = copied from flash at start-up, zero = zeroed, noload = left alone (survives reset), rom = constant data in that region.

examples.title: STM32F407 with CCM RAM for buffers
Bootloader offset app with a no-init crash log

usage: Give the memory regions (name, attributes rx/xrw/rw, origin as 0x hex, length like 512K), the names of the code and data regions, stack and heap sizes (bytes, 0x hex or K), the entry symbol, whether to include C++ init/exidx sections, and extra sections {name, region, kind: init|zero|noload|rom}. It returns the full .ld text (texts 'Linker script'), start-up C for extra sections, the _estack address, the reserved stack+heap share of RAM, a placement table, and warnings for overlaps, misalignment and a reservation that does not fit.
sources: GNU ld manual §3.6 SECTIONS, §3.6.8.2 output section LMA (AT>), §3.6.7 NOLOAD, §3.7 MEMORY
Arm AAPCS §6.2.1.2 stack alignment; Armv7-M ARM B3.2.5 VTOR alignment
